title: Deduplicate Linked List
statement:
Remove repeated values from an unsorted singly linked list.

Contract
- `head` may be null. Values may be any `int`.
- Keep the first node for each distinct value and remove later nodes whose value has already appeared.
- Preserve the relative order and identity of retained nodes, and return the original head when it is retained.
- You may use extra storage to remember values.

Examples
- `removeDuplicates([1, 2, 1, 3, 2])` returns `[1, 2, 3]`.
- `removeDuplicates([4, 4, 4])` returns `[4]`.
- `removeDuplicates([])` returns null.
hints: Walk the list once while remembering every value you have kept.
When the next node is a duplicate, bypass it instead of advancing the previous pointer.
Only advance the previous pointer when the next node is retained. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(n) extra space.
